strings.gwipeConfirm:
⚠️ Full Google wipe:

• Yi basisa Play Store + Google Play services + Services Framework data.
• ⛔ U TA sayiniwa eka ti account ta Google (u fanele u ti engetela nakambe).
• Swifaniso na ti-app ta wena a swi khumbiwanga.
• Xitirhisiwa reboots automatically after.

Xana wa tiyiseka?

strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: yi kambela bokisi ra swilotlelo ra sweswi ku ya hi nxaxamelo wa ku herisa wa Google (CRL) naswona yi ringeta swihlovo swo tala ku kondza yi kuma bokisi ra swilotlelo leri tirhaka, na vuhlayiselo bya otomatiki na ku sungula nakambe ka vukorhokeri bya Google. Yi tirha eka pompi yin’wana na yin’wana naswona yi lava internet (1-3 wa timinete).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox kusuka eka network: yi downloada keybox kusuka eka official repository (GitHub) yi yi hlayisa eka /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Yi lava internet naswona yi teka 1-3 wa timinete. Yi tirhisiwa loko smart fetch yi tsandzeka kumbe loko keybox yi cinciwile hi voko.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP diagnosis: yi kambela mimojula leyi nga kona ya Remote Key Provisioning, yi kambela TEE vhidiyo ya xitifikheti xa vumbhoni, naswona yi kombisa xiyimo xa xitirhisiwa xa KmInstallKeybox. Ku cinca nchumu — xivono xa xiyimo xa xitirhisiwa xo olova.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine check (ku hlayiwa ntsena): yi kombisa Widevine swikombiso swa xiyimo (L1/L3) ku suka eka dumpsys, vukona bya DRM (IDM) key-file, na swihlawulekisi swa sisiteme leswi fambelanaka. A nga cinci nchumu nikatsongo.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP lunghisa: yi tsutsuma sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. Ku lulamisa timhaka ta vumbhoni loko ku hundza ka otomatiki ku tsandzeka. Ku tsutsuma kun’wana na kun’wana ku kandziyisa layini leyi nga erivaleni ya ku humelela/ku tsandzeka.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Ku lulamisiwa loku heleleke RKP: ku tsutsuma sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh loku heleleke. Yi khoma ti case to tika naswona yi teka nkarhi wo leha. Vuyelo lebyi nga erivaleni byi humelela emakumu.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Seta GMS nakambe: yi basisa Play Store na Google vukorhokeri (GMS+GSF) data naswona yi pfula xitirhisiwa hi ku tisungulela. Ku tiyisisa ku nonoka ntsena — a yi si tshama yi khumba swifaniso kumbe tifayela ta wena.
strings.mdCertify: • Xitifikheti xa ku tlanga: xi kambela xiyimo xa xitifikheti xa RKP xa xitirhisiwa naswona xi tlhela xi veka swihlawulekisi swa vumbhoni loko swi laveka. A yi khumbi data ya mutirhisi.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER ku lunghisa: ku lulamisa Google timhaka ta rimba ra vukorhokeri (SOTER) leti fambelanaka na ku tiyisisiwa ka xitirhisiwa. Yi tirhisiwa eka switirhisiwa swin’wana leswi titshegeke hi SOTER ematshan’wini ya Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Tirhisa PIF: ku tsutsuma sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh matimba. Tirhisa xikombiso xa tintiho lexi hlawuriweke (xa laha kaya/xa le henhla) na ku pfuxeta tifayela ta pif.prop/pif.json. Vuyelo lebyi nga erivaleni byi humelela eka log.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF check: yi kombisa xiyimo xa njhini leyi nghenisiweke, tifayela ta swikombiso swa tintiho (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), na tilog. Check only — a yi cinca nchumu.
strings.mdCanary: • Ku pfuxetiwa ka Canary: ku tsutsuma sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Ku teka nkandziyiso wa sweswinyana wa Canary Engine ku tiyisisa ku fambisana na switifikheti leswi bohaka swa RKP (Hukuri 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Ku kamberiwa ka njhini: ku kambela xiyimo xa TrickyStoreOSS (pid, logs), tifayela ta bokisi ra swilotlelo (active vs user), fingerprint ya xitirhisiwa xa xiviri vs spoofed, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP keys. Xikombiso xa vukamberi ntsena.
strings.panelKbSlots: 🔐 Swilo swa bokisi ra swilotlelo (ya le henhla / ya le henhla) .
strings.hintKbSlots: Modyuli yi lawula swivandla swimbirhi swa bokisi ra swilotlelo: ya le henhla (yo kwetsima, leyi nga si tshamaka yi sula) na ya vumbirhi (ya vuhlayiselo). Thebhu leyi yi kombisa leswaku hi xihi xilotlelo lexi tirhaka, yi cinca ku tsakela, kumbe yi tlakusa ya vumbirhi ku ya eka ya le henhla eka xikombelo lexi nga erivaleni — na ti-backup na log leyi heleleke.
strings.btnIntegrityFix: 🔧 Ku hlayiseka ku tlhela u endla xikombelo
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Ku kamberiwa ka vutshembeki: ku kambela ku nghenisiwa ka xilotlelo xa TEE, ku nghenisiwa ka layiburari endzeni ka keystore2, xiyimo xa ku herisiwa (CRL), ku funengetiwa ka nxaxamelo wa nsirhelelo na xiyimo xa RKP. Ku hlaya ntsena — a swi cinci nchumu.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Safe re-apply:

• Nxaxamelo wa nsirhelelo wu akiwa nakambe ku suka eka app yin'wana na yin'wana leyi nghenisiweke.
• Leyara ya ku fambisana ka custom-ROM yi tirhisiwa nakambe.
• Bokisi ra swilotlelo leri tirhaka ri tirhisiwa nakambe.
• Google Play vukorhokeri byi sunguriwile nakambe.

A ku na nchumu yi susiwile naswona bokisi ra swilotlelo ra le henhla a ri si tshama ri khumbiwa.

Yana emahlweni?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Swilotlelo swa bokisi ra swilotlelo: swi kombisa xiyimo xa swivandla swa le henhla na swa vumbirhi naswona swi cinca-cinca ku tsakela exikarhi ka swona. Primary (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) yi tshama yi sirhelelekile naswona a yi si tshama yi sula. Ku tlakusa secondary ku ya eka primary swi lava ku tiyisisiwa loku nga erivaleni.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Tlakusa xilotlelo xa vumbirhi ku ya eka primary:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml yi hundzuka nhundzu ya xilotlelo xa le henhla.
• Primary ya sweswi yi hlayisiwa tanihi backup yi nga si cinciwa.
• A ku na nchumu lowu susiwaka — ntirho wa tlheriseriwa endzhaku.

Yana emahlweni?
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Clear secondary slot:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml yi ta susiwa.
• Xilotlelo xa primary a xi khumbiwi.

Yana emahlweni?

strings.confirmKbSmart:
Smart keybox fetch (yintshwa eka v3.17):

• Yi kambela bokisi ra swilotlelo ra sweswi ku ya hi nxaxamelo wa Google wo herisa (CRL).
• Yi ringeta swihlovo swo tala ku kondza ku kumiwa bokisi ra swilotlelo leri tengeke.
• Ku hlayisa vuhlayiselo bya otomatiki + ku sungula nakambe vukorhokeri bya Google.

⚠️ Swi laveka inthanete (1-3 wa timinete). Yisa emahlweni?
strings.confirmKbNet:
Fetch keybox from the internet:

• Yi dawuniloda keybox ya ximfumo yi yi tiyisisa.
• Yi nghenisiwile hi laha ku nga heriki (a yi si tshama yi tlheriseriwa endzhaku loko yi sungula).

⚠️ Yi lava inthanete (ku fika eka 1 min). Yisa emahlweni?
strings.confirmRkpManual:
Ku nyika nakambe swilotlelo swa RKP:

• Ku hava tifayela ta data kumbe ta bokisi ra swilotlelo leti susiweke.
• Ku pfula riqingho nakambe endzhaku ka sweswo.

Yana emahlweni?
strings.confirmRkpFull:
Ku lunghisa hi ku helela:

• Ku tlhela ku lunghisa RKP + ku sungula nakambe vukorhokeri bya Google.
• Xitirhisiwa xi pfula nakambe hi ku tisungulela (a ku na nchumu lowu sula).

Yana emahlweni?
strings.confirmGmsReset:
Sungula nakambe vukorhokeri bya Google:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — sungula nakambe ntsena.
• A ku na nchumu lowu sula naswona A WU nge humi.
• Xitirhisiwa xi sungula nakambe hi ku tisungulela.

Yana emahlweni?
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Force re-provision (Red Magic):

• Eka switirhisiwa leswi honisaka bokisi ra swilotlelo leri vupfeke.
• Swi tirha hambiloko swilotlelo swi hanye kahle.
• Ku hava data leyi susiweke.

Yana emahlweni?
strings.confirmCertify:
Force Play Store certification:

• Yi basisa ntsena cache ya Store — akhawunti ya wena a yi khumbiwanga.
• Reboot, kutani u pfula Store.

Yana emahlweni?
strings.confirmSoter:
SOTER ku lunghisa:

• Ku sungula nakambe vukorhokeri bya vendor.soter.
• Ku basisa SOTER data ya sevha ntsena.

Yana emahlweni?
strings.confirmPifApply:
Tirhisa fingerprint (PIF):

• Yi hundzula custom.pif.prop yi yi nghenisa eka ndlela ya njhini.
• Swi lava ku pfuriwa nakambe endzhaku ka sweswo.

Yana emahlweni?
strings.confirmCanary:
Update Canary fingerprint:

• Yi dawuniloda ximfumo xa sweswinyana xa Canary fingerprint ku suka eka Google.
• Yi fambisana na patch ya vuhlayiseki + yi sungula nakambe vukorhokeri bya Google (ku hava ku sula).

⚠️ Yi lava inthanete (1-3 min). Yisa emahlweni?
